 EFSC to Host Virtual Dual Enrollment Information Sessions
October 27, 2026 
 Eastern Florida State College will host two virtual information sessions this fall
 for students and families interested in learning how dual enrollment can help high
 school students earn free college credit while accelerating their educational and
 career goals.
 The online sessions are scheduled for:
 Wednesday, November 18, 2026, from 6 to 7 p.m.
 Monday, December 7, 2026, from 6 to 7 p.m.
 Participants will learn about the various dual enrollment pathways available through
 EFSC and how students can begin earning college credits while still in high school
 at no cost to eligible families.
 Dual enrollment provides students with an opportunity to experience the rigor of college
 coursework while building confidence and academic momentum before graduation. Students
 who participate can jump-start their college and career plans, reduce the time and
 cost required to earn a degree, and strengthen future college applications.
 The program has already delivered significant benefits to local families. During the
 2025-26 academic year, Brevard County families saved more than $6 million in tuition
 costs through participation in EFSC's dual enrollment program.
 Students and families can register for either information session at easternflorida.edu/go/dualpreview . For additional information, call 321-433-7614.
 Find out more about Eastern Florida State College at easternflorida.edu.
